functions.name: area
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the cross-section area of the cable element.

functions.name: component_id
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the ID of cable component id.

functions.name: density
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the density of cable elements.

functions.name: extra
functions.signature: itasca.structure.cablearray.extra(slot: int) -> array float{cable} or float{cable,3}
functions.description: Get the cable extra data in the given slot as an array. Extra variables accessed by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: force_axial
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the average axial force of the element (positive: tension; negative: compression).

functions.name: force_nodal
functions.description: Get the generalized nodal force acting at each end. The translational and rotational components of node 1 are given first.

functions.name: grout_cohesion
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the grout cohesion.

functions.name: grout_confining
functions.description: Get the confining stress acting on the grout at each end. Negative value indicates compression. The stress acts in a plane perpendicular to the cable axis; effective confining stress is the average of the principal values in this plane.

functions.name: grout_dir
functions.description: Get the direction vector in which cable is being loaded by the coupling spring for each end.

functions.name: grout_disp
functions.description: Get displacement in grout (shear coupling spring) at each end ; positive/negative with respect to the average axial direction of cable.

functions.name: grout_friction
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the grout internal friction angle.

functions.name: grout_perimeter
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the grout exposed perimeter.

functions.name: grout_slip
functions.description: Get the slip state of grout (shear coupling spring) at each end. Return value {0, 1, 2} denotes never slipped, now slipping, or slipped in the past, respectively.

functions.name: grout_stiffness
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the grout stiffness.

functions.name: grout_stress
functions.description: Get stress in grout (shear coupling spring) at each end; positive/negative with respect to average axial direction of cable.

functions.name: id
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the ID of cable element id.

functions.name: in_group
functions.description: Return cable group membership as a Boolean array.

functions.name: length
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the length of the cable element.

functions.name: local_system
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the local coordinate system of cable elements.

functions.name: mark
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the mark flag of cable elements.

functions.name: pos
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the current position of cable elements.

functions.name: set_area
functions.description: Set the cross-section area of the cable element.

functions.name: set_density
functions.description: Set the density of cable elements.

functions.name: set_extra
functions.signature: itasca.structure.cablearray.set_extra(slot: int, data: array float{cable} or float{cable, 3}) -> None
functions.description: Set the cable extra data in the given slot with an array. Extra variables set by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: set_group
functions.signature: itasca.structure.cablearray.set_group(membership: array bool{cable}, group_name: str, slot=1) -> None
functions.description: Set cable group from an array. Where membership True set the corresponding cable to be a member of group group_name in the given slot.

functions.name: set_grout_cohesion
functions.description: Set the grout cohesion.

functions.name: set_grout_friction
functions.description: Set the grout internal friction angle.

functions.name: set_grout_perimeter
functions.description: Set the grout exposed perimeter.

functions.name: set_grout_stiffness
functions.description: Set the grout stiffness.

functions.name: set_mark
functions.description: Set the mark flag of cable elements.

functions.name: set_slide
functions.description: Set the boolean flag of the large-strain sliding. If True, slide is on; if False, slide is off.

functions.name: set_slide_tol
functions.description: Set the large-strain sliding tolerance of the cable element.

functions.name: set_thermal_expansion
functions.description: Set the thermal expansion coefficient of cable elements.

functions.name: set_yield_compression
functions.description: Set the compression yield strength of the cable element.

functions.name: set_yield_tension
functions.description: Set the tension yield strength of the cable element.

functions.name: set_young
functions.description: Set the Youngs modulus of the cable element.

functions.name: slide
functions.description: Get the boolean flag of the large-strain sliding. If True, slide is on; if False, slide is off.

functions.name: slide_tol
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the large-strain sliding tolerance of the cable element.

functions.name: state_compression
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the compression yield state of the cable element. The return value {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively.

functions.name: state_tension
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the tension yield state of cable element. The return value {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively.

functions.name: stress_axial
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the average axial stress of the cable element (positive: tension; negative: compression.

functions.name: thermal_expansion
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the thermal expansion coefficient of cable elements.

functions.name: type
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the type name of cable elements.

functions.name: volume
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the cable element volume, or the cross-sectional area times the length.

functions.name: yield_compression
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the compression yield strength of the cable element.

functions.name: yield_tension
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the tension yield strength of the cable element.

functions.name: young
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the Youngs modulus of the cable element.
